title: aromatic molten venezuelan meal-prep empanadas
description: herbal, molten, meal-prep venezuelan dish featuring vanilla, mother-sauce-base, plant-based-friendly, vessel=cedar-plank

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: high-quality, pure vanille extract from madagascar

ingredients.name: plant-based ground beef
ingredients.notes: textured vegetable protein or plant-based ground beef alternative, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: white rice
ingredients.notes: cooked and cooled, then chopped into small grains

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: to coat empanadas, use gluten-free if necessary

instructions: soak 12 cedar planks in water for at least 30 minutes before use
in a large pan, combine mother-sauce-base, chopped onions, minced garlic, and plant-based ground beef
cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until heated through
stir in chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper
divide dough into 12 equal pieces and roll out into thin circles
place 1-2 tbsp of filling in center of each dough circle and brush edges with water
fold dough in half over filling and press edges to seal
brush tops of empanadas with melted coconut oil and sprinkle with liquid smoke
place empanadas on soaked cedar planks, 2-3 per plank
bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
